name: Audio Wavesurfer
description: Provides audio waveform visualization and playback via a field formatter using the wavesurfer.js library.
project_description: Audio Wavesurfer provides a field formatter that renders a Drupal media audio file as an interactive waveform player using the wavesurfer.js JavaScript library. The library is loaded from a CDN (jsDelivr) by default, or from a locally installed path configured at /admin/config/audio_wavesurfer/settings, where waveform/progress/cursor colors and bar geometry are also configurable. An optional 'Waveform Storage' feature uses FFmpeg (ffprobe) to pre-compute waveform peak data server-side on media save, storing a JSON peaks file and a 'waveform' content entity so the front end skips per-load peak calculation (useful for long audio). The bundled sub-module audio_wavesurfer_clips adds a widget/UI to define audio clip regions on top of the waveform, backed by the separate Audio Clips API module.
